'''Badali Jewlery Specialities, Inc''' is a company that has been licensed to create jewelry based on ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series. Below is a gallery of some of their creations.  All of Badali Jewelry's ''The Wheel of Time'' pieces were created with the assistance of Robert Jordan before he passed away.  Afterwards, all new pieces were approved directly by Harriet, Robert Jordan’s widow.

Production of jewelry stopped in 2019 after the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]] went into production. However, in 2021, the company started manufacturing jewelry based on the aesthetics of the television series.
